Internal helper: numbers given as a text variable's codes, quoted

Source: R/recode.R
dot-jst_jdeclare_text_quoted_line.Rd

The line to run when numbers were given for a text variable (ruling R26's lean 1): the same call on that variable with each number in quotes, its labels string as typed (a labels string is already text), and missing.notice = FALSE and modify = TRUE kept. A marker becomes its spelling (".a"); convention = and range = are left out, since a text variable takes neither.

Usage

.jst_jdeclare_text_quoted_line(
  data_name,
  vn,
  codes,
  labels,
  modify,
  missing.notice
)

Arguments

data_name

The data frame's name as the call gave it.

vn

The variable.

codes

The codes as parsed (numeric), or NULL.

labels

The labels string, or NULL.

modify, missing.notice

The call's flags.

Value

Character(1), indented two spaces.
